subject: Copywriting
title: The Wall Street Journal Letter
description: Learn The Wall Street Journal Letter in one minute.

hook.text: One sales letter ran for 28 years and generated over $2 billion in revenue.

buildup.text: Martin Conroy wrote it for The Wall Street Journal in 1975.

discovery.text: The difference? One read the Journal, the other didn't. The story sold knowledge as the competitive edge.

twist.text: The letter had no gimmicks, no offers, no countdown timers. Pure storytelling. The narrative did all the selling.

climax.text: $2 billion from one letter, unchanged for 28 years. No A/B test could beat it. Perfect copy exists.

punchline.text: Two men, one letter, $2 billion. The greatest sales letter ever.

quiz.question: How long did the Wall Street Journal sales letter run?
